context: PriceCalculator shows a running total after applying a discount and tax rate, with a reset button added in this change.
explanation: setTotal is called directly in the render body (guarded only by a value comparison), not inside an event handler or effect. Calling setState during render forces React to immediately re-render before committing, and since withTax is recomputed identically on the next pass while total lags behind, this pattern can cascade into repeated synchronous re-renders on every prop change. Fix: compute total with useMemo instead of syncing it into state.
